description: This Java class 'BusinessDateHelper' provides utility methods to manage and update the business date within the Fineract application. It includes methods to set the business date to a specific value or to today's date, and interacts with the 'BusinessDateManagementApi' for API calls. The class also defines constants related to date formatting and localization.

classes.name: BusinessDateHelper
classes.description: A helper class to manage business date operations such as setting the date, including to today's date, interacting with API services, and maintaining context within tests.

methods.name: setBusinessDate
methods.description: Sets the business date to a specified date by invoking the API and updating the test context.

methods.name: setBusinessDateToday
methods.description: Sets the business date to today's date formatted according to the specified date pattern.

methods.name: defaultBusinessDateRequest
methods.description: Creates a default 'BusinessDateUpdateRequest' with predefined type, date format, and locale.

methods.name: getBusinessDate
methods.description: Retrieves the current business date from the API.
